Use case: production 2D game terrain structural repaint. EDIT TARGET is the attached transparent 1536x1024 world terrain crop from our Godot game. Return the exact same canvas with real transparent empty spaces. Keep existing far left/right 220px and top/bottom 100px consistent in position/color for world joining. Preserve all authored walkable platform heights, door/arch openings, separate upper routes and intentional gaps.
The center x~520..1050 is a broken pasted panel with obvious vertical rectangular cut edges. Repaint the whole local bank and its attachment to BOTH neighbors into a single physically coherent organic landform. Remove every straight crop edge and detached leftover panel. Reconnect cut-off arch towers to their original upper/lower structure; any nonessential fragments should become natural irregular bone ends, not vertical crop strips. Main connecting walking lip crosses x~540..1000 at exactly y512; keep solid opaque pixels just below this height. Match bank thickness gradually, curve the supporting porous bone ribs continuously under the lip, and transition material/color through the same grown tissue. No geometric panel, no repeated obvious bridge tile. Existing left-right regional color differences should evolve within one landform, not at a straight line.
Maintain the original hand-painted side-view game art, muted dark coral-red flesh, gray-ivory porous bone, sparse attached algae/coral. Where the right side is ochre/gold digestive tissue, gradually warm the same tissue from left coral-pink to right ochre across the whole bank, never in a straight vertical strip. Preserve holes as transparent negative space. Solid ground and bone must be fully opaque inside their silhouettes (alpha255); no transparent ground, fog, glow matte, backdrop, blue water, UI, words, player, enemies, or new gameplay objects. Do not add a walkway at any un-authored height, nor close door openings. This is a replacement local world painting, not an isolated bridge pasted over the old collage.
